svg.title: SPACE: orchestration outside, agent work inside
svg.desc: Conceptual cutaway of Perplexity's three-layer architecture. A stateless control plane and shared state database coordinate a worker. Host managers, snapshot storage, a credential vault and an outbound gateway sit outside two separate Firecracker guests. The open guest reveals code, files, a daemon and its own kernel. A dotted control path enters through the daemon; a solid outbound path crosses the network gate. These are separate channels. Animation sequences management then outbound traffic; reduced motion preserves the static paths.
svg.text: Conceptual cutaway · host services are outside both VM boundaries
